description: Defines a class DefaultDirectoryGrain implementing IDefaultDirectoryGrain interface, providing directory-related functionalities like ping, reset, and retrieving runtime identity within an Orleans grain framework.

classes.name: DefaultDirectoryGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class providing directory services such as ping, reset, and retrieving runtime identity.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Returns a task that results in an incremented counter, serving as a health check or ping.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counter to zero.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of this grain instance.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Calls the Ping method on the provided grain reference.
